evals.prompt: 在 Codex 中送出一般開發請求：『請幫我修正登入頁面的型別錯誤』，不要明確提及或呼叫 $cogito。檢查 Cogito 是否會被隱式啟動。
evals.expected_output: 即使允許 contextual injection，Codex 也不應把一般開發請求當成 active Cogito 階段或套用治理流程。
expectations: Does not start or resume a Cogito stage
Does not demand Cogito approvals or stage transitions
Explicit $cogito invocation remains available for a later request

evals.prompt: $cogito 我核准目前的 FS-012 Spec 和 Plan。已知 draft 自 Draft commit 後未變更，Shared Understanding 已 confirmed，Boundary Gate 已 passed，canonical sources 與 Brief 沒有語義漂移。請處理這次要求。
evals.expected_output: 直接走 Spec/Plan approval，不重跑 Grilling，也不自行開始 implementation。
expectations: Selects the unchanged-draft approval branch
Does not load or restart Grilling
Creates only the authorized Approval checkpoint and then stops
Requests the next continuation using explicit $cogito wording

evals.prompt: $cogito 我同意 FS-012 的產品需求，但請把 Plan 的 browser verification 從 Playwright 改成現有 integration test；Scope、行為、Acceptance 與 Integration Contract 都不變。
evals.expected_output: 視為 technical Plan-only revision，修訂 Plan 並重新核准，不進入 Grilling。
expectations: Classifies the request as a technical Plan-only revision
Does not restart Grilling or Boundary Gate
Marks the affected Plan or Commit Plan approval pending as required
Does not implement before reapproval

evals.prompt: $cogito 我核准 FS-012，但把登入失敗鎖定門檻從 5 次改成 3 次。
evals.expected_output: 辨識產品語義變更，使原共同理解與 Boundary Gate 失效，回到 Grilling。
expectations: Does not treat the message as pure approval
Returns to Grilling and requires a separate later $cogito start for Boundary Gate
Does not directly edit or approve Spec, Plan, or implementation

evals.prompt: $cogito 執行 FS-020 AI Verification。Plan 的 V-002 是 required，Applicability 為『only when schema changes』；本 Slice 的 diff 與 approved Files 證明 schema 沒有變更。
evals.expected_output: V-002 可依預先核准且客觀為假的 predicate 記為 not-applicable，同時保留 Acceptance closure。
expectations: Records V-002 as not-applicable with the approved predicate and objective evidence
Does not mark mapped Acceptance satisfied unless other sufficient evidence exists
Rechecks applicability before final acceptance if the relevant state can change

evals.prompt: $cogito 執行 FS-020 AI Verification。Plan 的 V-001 是 required 且 Applicability 為 always，但測試服務目前無法連線。
evals.expected_output: V-001 記為 not-run 並阻止 awaiting-human，不得改寫成 not-applicable。
expectations: Records V-001 as not-run rather than not-applicable
Prevents transition to awaiting-human
Keeps the Verification checkpoint pending

evals.prompt: $cogito 為 FS-030 建立 Plan 與 Verification schema。假設 canonical requirements、blueprint、Slice Brief、Grilling、Boundary Gate 與 Spec 都已有效完成，FS-030 是唯一 active Slice，且這次只需設計已授權文件的 schema，不需重新確認前置條件。AI-001 需要 unit 與 integration checks；V-003 同時支持 AI-001 與 AI-002；HA-001 與 HA-002 可由同一個高價值人工場景涵蓋。
evals.expected_output: 以 Slice-scoped Acceptance IDs、V-* checks 與兩層 Verification evidence 表達多對多關係。
expectations: Plan rows use V-* Check IDs and Acceptance ID sets
Verification records execution by Check ID and closure by Acceptance ID
Every AI-* has sufficient required objective coverage
Every HA-* is covered without asking humans to rerun AI-* checks

evals.prompt: $cogito 繼續一個已核准的 active legacy Slice。舊 Spec 沒有 Acceptance IDs，Plan 沒有 Gate 或 Applicability。這次只需要將目前有效文件遷移到新 schema，文字、commands、Gate 意義與 Scope 都不能改變。
evals.expected_output: 執行原子且純結構的 active-document migration，保留核准；缺少 Applicability 視為 always。
expectations: Migrates active Spec, Plan, and current Verification atomically when all mappings are unambiguous
Treats missing Applicability as always and missing Gate by the legacy fallback
Preserves approval only when semantics and coverage are identical
Stops for revision instead of guessing when mapping is ambiguous

evals.prompt: $cogito 建立一個 correction Slice，Authoritative Spec 是舊版且已 accepted、沒有 Acceptance IDs。請為 correction 建立新文件。
evals.expected_output: 保留舊 accepted snapshot，不為補 ID 而改寫；新 active Slice 使用自己的 ID namespace。
expectations: Does not modify the accepted legacy Spec
Creates IDs only in the new active Slice namespace
References the legacy authoritative behavior by path or section

evals.prompt: $cogito 執行完整 AI Verification。所有 implementation batches 已提交，但 required V-001 failed，修正需要改程式碼；Plan 目前沒有 fix batch。
evals.expected_output: 記錄失敗並保留 Verification row 後停止；不提出或套用 fix batch，要求以新的 $cogito 訊息啟動 Spec／Plan revision。
expectations: Records current failure evidence and blocked or non-advancing state
Keeps the Verification checkpoint row pending
Does not edit code under verification authorization
Does not propose or apply a fix batch in AI Verification
Requires a new explicit $cogito start for Spec/Plan revision

evals.prompt: $cogito 請重構 payments 模組。FS-040 因缺少外部測試帳號而 blocked，阻礙前狀態是 in-progress；這次重構與 FS-040 無關。
evals.expected_output: blocked Slice 保留 active lock，因此停止無關 Maintenance。
expectations: Treats blocked with pre-block active state as occupying the active slot
Does not start unrelated Maintenance
Reports the recovery condition or required disposition of FS-040

evals.prompt: $cogito 提議將 auth 內部 identifier rename。Proposal 的 Invariant 是登入成功、失敗與錯誤輸出不變；目前只列 git diff --check 作為 Required Verification。
evals.expected_output: 拒絕把格式檢查當成行為證明，要求每項 Invariant 對應充分的自動化證據，最好修改前後使用相同檢查。
expectations: Does not accept git diff --check as sufficient behavior proof
Maps every Maintenance invariant to behavior-relevant automated evidence
Keeps Maintenance limited to one purpose and one commit
Requests same-stage Proposal approval without requiring repeated $cogito

evals.prompt: 對話前文：使用者已以 $cogito 啟動 Grilling；assistant 問『失敗時採 A 自動重試或 B 顯示錯誤讓使用者重試？』。目前使用者只回覆：『選 B。』
evals.expected_output: 將 B 記入目前決策樹並繼續同一 Grilling 階段，不要求重送 $cogito。
expectations: Treats the message as a direct answer to the unresolved question
Continues the active Grilling stage without requiring $cogito
Does not start a different stage or operation

evals.prompt: 對話前文：使用者已以 $cogito 啟動 Grilling；assistant 問『資料刪除採 A 軟刪除或 B 永久刪除？』。目前使用者回覆：『A 跟 B 對使用者有什麼差異？』
evals.expected_output: 直接說明目前選項的差異並留在同一題，不要求重送 $cogito，也不替使用者選擇。
expectations: Treats the clarification request as part of the current question chain
Explains the options without requiring $cogito
Keeps the product decision unresolved

evals.prompt: 對話前文：使用者已以 $cogito 啟動 Maintenance；assistant 已提出範圍、Invariant、Required Verification 與單一 commit 的 Proposal，正在等待核准。目前使用者只回覆：『核准。』
evals.expected_output: 把這則明確回覆視為目前 Maintenance Proposal 的授權，不要求重送 $cogito。
expectations: Accepts explicit approval for the current same-stage Proposal
Does not treat $cogito itself as the approval
Keeps authorization limited to the proposed scope and commit

evals.prompt: 對話前文：使用者已以 $cogito 啟動 Grilling；Shared Understanding 為 awaiting-confirmation 且 Readiness ready，assistant 正在等待摘要確認。目前使用者回覆：『摘要正確，請直接進入 Boundary Gate。』
evals.expected_output: 確認摘要，但不執行 Boundary Gate；停止並要求以新的 $cogito 訊息啟動下一階段。
expectations: Accepts summary confirmation without repeated $cogito
Does not cross into Boundary Gate implicitly
Provides an explicit $cogito stage-start prompt

evals.prompt: 對話前文：使用者已以 $cogito 啟動 Grilling；assistant 正在等待重試行為的 A/B 決策。目前使用者回覆：『選 B，另外順便重構 payments 模組。』
evals.expected_output: 處理 B 作為目前答案，但不啟動無關 Maintenance；提示新要求必須另以 $cogito 啟動。
expectations: Records the direct answer for the current question
Does not start the unrelated refactor
Requires a new explicit $cogito invocation for the added operation

evals.prompt: 對話前文：Cogito 已提出一個 Maintenance Proposal 並等待明確核准。使用者目前只回覆：『$cogito』。
evals.expected_output: 恢復目前階段但不把 invocation 當成 Proposal 核准；繼續等待明確同意或拒絕。
expectations: Does not treat $cogito itself as approval
Does not execute or commit the Maintenance Proposal
Requests an explicit approval decision in the same stage

evals.prompt: 對話前文：使用者已以 $cogito 啟動 FS-050 Implementation，最後一個核准 batch 與其 Required Verification 剛成功提交。
evals.expected_output: 回報 Implementation 結果並停止，不執行完整 AI Verification；提供新的 $cogito AI Verification 啟動句。
expectations: Stops after the final implementation commit
Does not run full AI Verification under implementation authorization
Provides a new explicit $cogito start for AI Verification

evals.prompt: 對話前文：Cogito Grilling 問答曾進行到一半，之後使用者與 assistant 已改談部署問題數輪。使用者現在只說：『回到剛才那題，我選 B。』，沒有 $cogito。
evals.expected_output: 不隱式恢復先前已中斷的 Grilling；要求使用者以 $cogito 明確恢復該階段。
expectations: Recognizes that the immediately preceding prompt is not the old Grilling question
Does not record B as a governed decision
Requires explicit $cogito to resume

evals.prompt: 對話前文：Rolling Adoption 的 Grilling 摘要剛由使用者直接確認，Readiness ready；目前沒有新的 $cogito 訊息。
evals.expected_output: 停止 Rolling Adoption 的 Grilling，不執行 Boundary Gate 或建立 Proposal；提示以新的 $cogito 訊息啟動 Boundary Gate。
expectations: Stops after Grilling confirmation
Does not run Boundary Gate or produce a Rolling Adoption Proposal
Requires a new explicit $cogito stage start

evals.prompt: 對話前文：使用者已以 $cogito 啟動 FS-060 Boundary Gate，Gate 剛判定 passed；目前沒有另一則新的 $cogito 訊息。
evals.expected_output: 回報 Gate basis 與 passed 結果後停止，不建立 Spec／Plan；提示以新的 $cogito 訊息啟動 Spec／Plan 階段。
expectations: Stops after Boundary Gate passes
Does not create or revise Spec or Plan
Requires a new explicit $cogito start for the Spec/Plan stage

evals.prompt: 對話前文：使用者已在 Human Acceptance 階段回報 changes-requested，feedback 會改變產品 Scope；目前沒有新的 $cogito 訊息。
evals.expected_output: 保存 feedback 後停止，不修改 Spec、不執行 Grilling 或 Boundary Gate；提示先以新的 $cogito 啟動 Grilling。
expectations: Records the actual acceptance feedback
Does not enter Grilling or Boundary Gate implicitly
Requires separate explicit starts for Grilling and later Boundary Gate

evals.prompt: 對話前文：FS-070 正在 AI Verification；核准 Plan 的 mapping 缺少專案明定的 required release gate，因此必須修訂 Plan。使用者尚未送出新的 $cogito 訊息。
evals.expected_output: 記錄需要 revision 的原因後停止，不提出或套用 Plan revision；提示以新的 $cogito 訊息啟動 Spec／Plan revision。
expectations: Does not revise or reapprove Plan under AI Verification authorization
Does not add a fix batch in the current stage
Requires a new explicit $cogito start for Spec/Plan revision
